name: readdirTree
description: Bounded-depth recursive directory listing. Rows carry a root-relative '/'-separated path, kind, size and mtime, so one call can index a whole tree without a stat per entry. Depth-capped: directories AT the cap are listed but not descended.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Root directory to scan (relative paths resolve against cwd).

inputs.name: maxDepth
inputs.description: Levels below `path` to descend. 1 = the root's own children (readdir parity). Absent or <= 0 means 1; clamped to 8.

inputs.name: maxEntries
inputs.description: Hard cap on returned rows; the scan stops when reached and sets truncated=true. Absent or <= 0 means 20000; clamped to 50000.
